purpose: Latin Modern text TFMs beyond the five Commander-pinned files, so 5-17 pt regular, 5-12 pt bold, 7-12 pt italic, 10 pt bold-italic and 5-10 pt roman-math documents lay out with TeX metrics in the no-TeX bundle (GH34/GH36).

provenance.copied_from: /usr/local/texlive/2026/texmf-dist/fonts/tfm/public/lm (MacTeX 2026; TeX Live package lm revision 77682, catalogue-version 2.005; MANIFEST-Latin-Modern.TXT version 2.004, 30 X 2009)
provenance.cross_checked: byte-identical to the same members of the CTAN lm.zip present on the build machine (sha256 71c48809cb50fbfe09c8eddaa251398957c7b243acdf69f7f807268f0d42c939, 18709543 bytes) - a second official distribution copy, NOT the Commander-pinned lm2.004bas.zip (97a725ea...)
provenance.limitation: not verified against the pinned 2.004 archive hash; the five Commander-pinned 2.004 files matched these same sources byte-for-byte, which is the evidence that the TFMs are unchanged between 2.004 and 2.005. The hashes below are the in-repository pin; make-app.sh refuses packaging if any vendored file drifts from them.

not_covered: lmmi/lmsy/lmex math families (drawn from the Latin Modern Math OTF by the producer), dunhill, and 11 pt masters (Latin Modern has none: 11 pt uses the 10/12 pt masters scaled by the producer's fd tables). The T1 Computer Modern sans metrics ecss/ecsi/ecsx/ecso that ec_tfm_file returns for FamilyKind::Sf are covered by the sans tier below. Roman shapes ec_tfm_file can name but for which no jknappen file exists or is reachable (eccc, ecui, ecsc, ecbl, ecxc, ecoc, ecrb) remain uncovered.

ec_provenance.purpose: GH111 (PR #111): the render pipeline lays T1 cmr documents out with the EC metrics t1cmr.fd loads (ecrm/ecbx/ecti/ecbi/ecsl at the 14 sizes t1cmr.fd declares) when [T1]{fontenc} is loaded without lmodern (fonts.rs EC_TFM_DIR/ec_tfm_file); bundled so a no-TeX app still gets exact T1 widths instead of the ec_metrics_unavailable fallback diagnostic.

ams_symbols_provenance.purpose: mathbb glyph advances must come from msbm10.tfm (and msam10.tfm), not the OTF face metrics (measured -0.91pt/glyph vs pdflatex on the double-struck R). Bundled at 5/7/10pt for a producer that reads them directly (GH111 follow-up; not yet consumed by render-pipeline as of this change - see BundledMetrics.swift doc comment).
ams_symbols_provenance.license: doc/fonts/amsfonts/README (LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c or later, American Mathematical Society) copied byte-for-byte alongside the metrics.

tt_provenance.purpose: \texttt/\ttfamily/verbatim geometry. fonts.rs ec_tfm_file maps (Tt, M, {N,Sl,It,Sc}) to ectt/ecst/ecit/ectc and latin_modern_tfm maps the lmmono* outlines to ec-lmtt/ec-lmtti/ec-lmtto/ec-lmtcsc/ec-lmtcso/ec-lmtk/ec-lmtko, but none of those files were vendored: every typewriter run on this bundle warned ec_metrics_unavailable + font_outline_substituted and was laid out on substituted roman metrics. These 54 TFMs are every file those two tables can return for FamilyKind::Tt (t1cmtt.fd declares <5><6><7><8>#50800, so 5/6/7 pt share 0800, and T1/cmtt bx/n and bx/it ssub to m/n and m/it - no bold ec file exists or is reachable).

ec_shapes_provenance.purpose: ec_tfm_file (crates/render-pipeline/src/fonts.rs) maps the remaining T1 Computer Modern text roles to eccc (Rm m/sc), ecsc (m/scsl), ecoc (bx|b/scsl), ecui (m/ui), ecbl (bx/sl), ecrb (b/n), ecxc (bx/sc) and the sans ecss (Sf m/n), ecsi (m/sl|it), ecsx (bx/n), ecso (bx/sl|it). None were vendored, so a [T1]{fontenc} document without lmodern that used any of those shapes found no metric file and degraded all the way to a Core-14 face: the font-families oracle measured 20-t1-rm-bfsc 11.533 bp from pdflatex, which sets it from SFXC1000 (= ecxc1000.tfm). With these 142 files ec_tfm_file can no longer name a metric the bundle lacks: 7 roman families at the 14 declared t1cmr.fd sizes, plus 4 sans families at the 11 distinct sizes t1cmss.fd reaches (it declares <5><6><7><8>#50800, so 5/6/7 pt share 0800).
ec_shapes_provenance.copied_from: /nix/store/l7fr37hc3k7wgpavm25lcyndwwghwb9x-texlive-2025-r78234-final-env-texmfdist (TeX Live 2025 r78234 on linux-primary; package jknappen)
ec_shapes_provenance.cross_checked: Same byte-comparison gate as the face tier: all 191 files already pinned from packages lm, jknappen and amsfonts compare equal (cmp) between this tree and the pins, which is what establishes that this distribution is the release the earlier tiers were cut from.
